name: Access
overview: Scripture reveals that access to God is granted through Jesus Christ, who is described as the door and the way to the Father, emphasizing that no one comes to God except through Him. Believers receive this access by faith and the Spirit, enabling them to stand in grace and rejoice in the hope of God's glory. The Psalms affirm that God draws chosen individuals near to dwell in His presence, and that He is close to all who call on Him sincerely, highlighting the personal and gracious nature of this access.
